function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_pie_chart.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create a pie chart with 20 equal slices
labels = list(range(1, 21))
sizes = [1] * 20  # All slices are equal

# Create the pie chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax.pie(sizes, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)

# Set the background color to dark gray
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#333333')
ax.set_facecolor('#333333')

# Set the font size of slice labels to exactly 4 points
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(4)

# Set the font size of the percentage labels to 4 points as well
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(4)

# Equal aspect ratio ensures that pie is drawn as a circle
ax.axis('equal')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved to figure.png")
EOF
"}
